events.what: Wang and Zahl prove the Kakeya set conjecture in three dimensions (Hausdorff and Minkowski dimension 3)

judgement.doubts: None material. The bullet asks about general n, so the n=3 proof is a case; n>3 remains open per the record. Digestion is strong (Tao's blog, Guth's surveys, Fields Medal citation), though it does not change the tier for a case.
